verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents custom dashboards: collections of charts you configure yourself, with group-by on run tags or metadata. Prebuilt dashboards cover error rates and token usage. However, the evidence names latency, cost and feedback score only as alerting metrics, not as chartable dashboard metrics, and does not show eval scores plotted in custom dashboards. missing for 10: explicit documentation that latency, cost and eval/feedback-score metrics can be charted in custom dashboards, independent or hands-on corroboration of custom dashboard building

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can build custom dashboards over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics

citations.quote: Custom dashboards: Collections of charts you can configure to your needs.
Create tailored collections of charts for tracking metrics that matter most for your application.
Prebuilt dashboards are created automatically for each project and cover essential metrics, such as trace count, error rates, token usage, and more.
You can use group by run tag or metadata to split data over attributes that are important to your application.
